title.zh: 修订第2701号共和国法（即《公共工程拨款法》，使与其此前公共工程拨款相协调）若干项目的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred, and One, Entitled "An Act to Appropriate Funds for Public Works, Synchronizing the Same With Previous Public Works Appropriations
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred, and One, Entitled "An Act to Appropriate Funds for Public Works, Synchronizing the Same With Previous Public Works Appropriations

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3298_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (e), page 218, Group II, for the Province of Negros Oriental, under Subsection (b) of Section two of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and one is hereby amended to read as follow:
"(e) Cabulihan Home Economics School Building, Larena ₱1,000.00 "(ee)Cabulihan Shop Building, Larena Construction 5,000.00 "(eee) Improvement of school premises, Cabuiihan Elementary School, Larena 4,000.00

Item (m), page 532, under Subsection (e), Section two, entitled "For Reconstruction, Improvement and Repair of Nation Wide Selected Projects," for the Province of Negros Oriental, of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(m) Tapon Elementary School, Larena Construction and/or improvement ₱5,000.00 "(mm)Building for Home Industries Projects, Larena 5,000.00"

Item (a), under "Siquijor," page 534, under Subsection (c), Section two, entitled, "For Reconstruction, Improvement and Repair of Nation Wide Selected Projects," for the Province of Negros Oriental, of the same Act, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(a) Minalolan Shop Building, Maria ₱5,000.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 18, 1961.
